dedupe_keys.name: long time series 2001 2015 1 km crop yield and water productivity dataset of china maize and wheat

description: This dataset gives 1 km annual crop yield (kg per hectare) and crop water productivity (kg per cubic metre) for maize and wheat across China from 2001 to 2015. The Zenodo record says it was built with a random forest from the MOD16 evapotranspiration product, remotely sensed crop and environmental indicators and crop phenology, with relative RMSE of about 27 and 22 percent locally and 15 and 17 percent regionally for maize and wheat. It was published in July 2021 by Cheng Minghan of Hohai University (version 1.0) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as four zips of about 75 MB. Coverage is China. Caveats: yields are modelled, not reported, and the file format inside the zips is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives gridded yield and water productivity to model drought and irrigation impacts on grain supply. Related catalogue records include ADIA-CMGR drought impact data and the Chinese provincial food demand data.
name: Long time series (2001-2015) 1 km crop yield and water productivity dataset of China (maize and wheat)
provider: Cheng Minghan, Hohai University, via Zenodo
